page.overview:
Who is Carlos Remedi?

is a bartender at the Lavish Chateau in Nicodranas. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

He has a thick mustache and combed-over hair.

Carlos quickly covered for Beau when she brought a cart full of fireworks to the Lavish Chateau, followed by suspicious Zhelezo. While he seemed a little perturbed he was now a conspirator in this, he let her bring them in with no hesitation, just asking she not stash them near the lantern oil, and helped her hide them.
